title: Domain and SSL
meta: We connect your domain, set up DNS and email records and keep your SSL certificates renewing. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Domain and SSL set up so your site stays secure
overview: We point your domain at your site or app, set up the DNS records correctly and install an HTTPS certificate that renews on its own. We also fix common problems: www and non-www redirects, mixed content warnings, missing email records that send mail to spam and domains pointing at old servers. We do this without taking your site offline, and write down every record we changed.

pkgs.blurb: One domain connected with HTTPS switched on.
Subdomains, email records and a clean redirect plan.
Several domains, a CDN and renewal alerts, with a records sheet.

faq: Do I need to own the domain already?
Yes. You buy and own the domain at a registrar such as Namecheap or GoDaddy, and give us DNS access or add us as a delegate. We cannot register it in our name. We can advise on what to buy.
No. We prepare the new records first and switch at a quiet time. DNS changes can take a few hours to spread, and we keep the old records in place until the new ones work.
Do you set up wildcard certificates?
Yes, as an add-on, for sites with many subdomains. The standard certificates are free and renew automatically, and we confirm renewal works before handover.
Can you move my domain to another registrar?
In the Premium package we help with the transfer steps, such as releasing the domain lock and authorization codes. You keep the codes and approve the transfer yourself, because only the owner can.
